---
name: Bug with reproduction
about: Report observed incorrect behavior and a reproducible case
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## GOAL
State the incorrect behavior and intended result.

## SCOPE
Identify the affected behavior and boundaries of the proposed fix.

## CONTEXT
Include exact reproduction steps, expected/actual output, version or commit,
OS/Node version, and a sanitized fixture or failing test. Do not include keys
or private session content. Mark an unconfirmed report as needing reproduction.

## ACCEPTANCE
List observable conditions that demonstrate the bug is fixed.

## VERIFY
Give the reproduction/focused test command and the full `npm run check` gate.

## TIMEBOX
Set the session/checkpoint budget and when to report a blocker.

## FORBIDDEN
List excluded changes. No weakened tests, unrelated fixes, or protected edits.

## REPORT
Require issue/PR links, tested SHA, before/after evidence, check results,
independent review, and rollback.
